champions.name: Rengar
champions.tldr: The duration for preserving Ferocity|buzzword3 stacks now starts as per V25.24 behaviour, no longer generically based on combat status.; Bug: While the Ferocity|buzzword3 timer is not running, if the attack blind or i…
champions.gameplayImpact: Rengar was adjusted in mixed directions. Net power depends on playstyle — read the numbers before assuming a free buff or hard nerf.

lines.label: Change
lines.note: Bug Fix: Leaping just before empowered attack buff times out, should now properly extend its duration until the attack has finished.

lines.label: Undocumented: Out of combat Ferocity|buzzword3 timer from casting an ability
lines.note: Undocumented: Out of combat Ferocity|buzzword3 timer from casting an ability reduced to 1 second from 1.5 seconds.

lines.label: Change
lines.note: Undocumented / Bug Fix: When 4 Ferocity|buzzword3 stacks expire, last ability slot used should no longer be locked out for 0.1 seconds.

lines.label: Change
lines.note: Undocumented / Bug: While out of combat, if abilities are used one after the other, only the first will count towards the 1 second Ferocity|buzzword3 timer, no longer refreshing from the second cast.

lines.label: Change
lines.note: The duration for preserving Ferocity|buzzword3 stacks now starts as per V25.24 behaviour, no longer generically based on combat status.

lines.label: Change
lines.note: Bug Fix: Starting the leap, but not hitting the attack should no longer lose all Ferocity|buzzword3 stacks, as per V25.24 behaviour.

lines.label: Change
lines.note: Bug Fix: Generating a Ferocity|buzzword3 stack just before the preservation duration times out, and entering combat after that, should now prevent the stacks from immediatelly falling off, as per V25.24 behaviour.

lines.label: Change
lines.note: Bug Fix: Melee attacks from brush should now properly reveal Rengar, as per V25.24 behaviour.

lines.label: Change
lines.note: Undocumented / Bug Fix: Bonetooth HUD display should now disappear when meant to, as per V25.24 behaviour.

lines.label: Change
lines.note: Bug Fix: Fixed an issue where Rengar's Q was being consumed by on-hit augments without granting ferocity.

lines.label: Change
lines.note: Undocumented / Bug Fix: Now guarantees the Ferocity|buzzword3 is temporarily generated even when not entering combat, similar to the other abilities.

lines.label: Change
lines.note: Bug: While the Ferocity|buzzword3 timer is not running, if the attack blind or it's dodge it will now grant a permanent Ferocity|buzzword3 stack until the timer is triggered and refreshed.

lines.label: Change
lines.note: Bug Fix: Attack speed buff should now be consumed after 2 attacks, instead of 3, as per V25.24 behaviour.

lines.label: Change
lines.note: Bug Fix: Ability's damage is now additionally tagged as basic damage, instead of just proc damage, now properly being reduced by Plated Steelcaps}}, as per V25.24 behaviour.

lines.label: Change
lines.note: This also causes the ability's damage to now grant an additional stack of Black Cleaver}}.

lines.label: Change
lines.note: Undocumented: Should now grant base attack speed buff on cast and the empowered version on-hit, as per V25.24 behaviour.

lines.label: Change
lines.note: Unlike V25.24, the buffs gained on cast from the unempowered and empowered version can now stack.

lines.label: Change
lines.note: Undocumented / Bug Fix: Should now be consumed when it blind or is dodge, same as the unempowered version, as per V25.24 behaviour.

lines.label: Change
lines.note: Undocumented / Bug Fix: The 0.1 second lockout after cast should now apply only to the abilty slot itself, instead of the last ability slot used, as per V25.24 behaviour.

lines.label: Change
lines.note: Bug Fix: Pressing the ability immediately after Savagery 2|Empowered Savagery}} or Bola Strike 2|Empowered Bola Strike}} should now grant the heal.

lines.label: Change
lines.note: Bug Fix: Fixed an issue where Rengar's leap would be delayed by up to 0.325s when casting R or flashing during R.

lines.label: Change
lines.note: Bug Fix: Fixed an issue where melee during Rengar's R would sometimes not grant a ferocity stack.

lines.label: Change
lines.note: Undocumented / Bug Fix: Rengar is no longer incorrectly visible near the Nexus.

lines.label: Change
lines.note: Bug Fix: Ability's damage is now additionally tagged as basic damage, instead of just proc damage, now properly being reduced by Plated Steelcaps}}, as per V25.24 behaviour.

lines.label: Change
lines.note: This also causes the ability's damage to now grant an additional stack of Black Cleaver}}.

lines.label: Change
lines.note: Bug Fix: Damage sequence changed to apply the shred after the ability's damage, as per V25.24 behaviour.

lines.label: Change
lines.note: Bug Fix: Fixed an issue where Sylas stealing Rengar ult would lose all mana on leap, as per V25.24 behaviour.
